class.name: YAMLSecurity
class.brief_description: Controls resource loading security during YAML parsing.
class.description: Controls resource loading security during YAML parsing by allowing you to specify which resource paths and types are permitted. This protects against security vulnerabilities when loading YAML from untrusted sources. When parsing YAML that contains resource references (using the [code]!Resource[/code] tag), [YAMLSecurity] validates whether the referenced resource paths and types are allowed. By default, Script and GDExtension resource types are blocked for security reasons. Customize security settings by allowing specific paths, blocking specific resource types, or using a combination of both.

method.name: allow_path
method.description:
Permits resource loading from the specified path prefix. If [param type_names] is empty, allows all non-blocked resource types from this path. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Create security settings var security = YAML.create_security()
# Allow all non-blocked resource types from assets directory security.allow_path("res://assets/")
# Allow only specific resource types from textures directory security.allow_path("res://textures/", ["Texture2D", "Image"]) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: block_type
method.description: Blocks a specific resource type globally, regardless of path. YAML parsing rejects any resource of this type.

method.name: clear_path_restrictions
method.description: Removes all path restrictions. After calling this method, all paths will be allowed until you call [method allow_path].

method.name: clear_type_restrictions
method.description: Removes all type restrictions. After this call, all resource types will be allowed unless explicitly blocked again. [b]Note:[/b] By default, Script and GDExtension types are blocked for security reasons. Calling this method removes these default restrictions, which may introduce security vulnerabilities.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets security settings to defaults. Clears all custom settings and re-adds the default blocked types (Script and GDExtension).
